I cannot afford to buy chemical fertilizer for this small rented plot, especially since beans do not need much nitrogen and I must save money for the rent and for my family. I will spread whatever manure and compost I have from my animals to help the soil, and I will plant the bean seed we saved from last season because it is free and I know it grows well here. My wife, children, and I will do all the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves by hand since the plot is small and hiring workers is too expensive.
